Watched online-test pages (fake InSIS)

Built by build.py from the fake online-test page. Serve with python test/serve.py. Each page keeps window.__watchLog (what its handlers saw) and window.__reports (what it sent to http://localhost:8765/__report; 404/501 answers there are expected, as are 404s for watch-main.js/watch.js until they exist).

  • jquery-report.html (classic: a test being written) · jquery-report-plus.html (InSIS+ view: the list of tests) — jQuery copy/cut/paste reporter
    Watches: jQuery $(document).on('copy cut paste') (one native listener per event type on document, added by jQuery); reports with $.ajax GET
    Expected: Warning lists copy, cut and paste listeners on document. A copy through the copy button must leave __watchLog and __reports empty.
